evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies script decompression in src/compressor.h, used in UTXO database serialization.
rationale: Prevents corrupted UTXO script decompression from silently producing anyone-can-spend empty scripts instead of raising an error. The author notes that `ScriptCompression::Unser` previously ignored the `DecompressScript` return value, allowing an unspendable off-curve P2PK under corruption to turn into an empty spendable script.
